A gitoid may represent either an [Artifact Identifier](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-identifier-types) for the software artifact or an [Input Manifest Identifier](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#input-manifest-identifier) for the software artifact's associated [Artifact Input Manifest](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-input-manifest); this ambiguity exists because the Artifact Input Manifest is itself an artifact, and the gitoid of that artifact is its valid identifier. Gitoids calculated on software artifacts (Snippet, File, or Package Elements) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 SoftwareArtifact's contentIdentifier property. Gitoids calculated on the Artifact Input Manifest (Input Manifest Identifier) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 Element's externalIdentifier property. See [OmniBOR Specification](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/), a minimalistic specification for describing software [Artifact Dependency Graphs](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-dependency-graph-adg).

Gitoids calculated on software artifacts (Snippet, File, or Package Elements) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 SoftwareArtifact's contentIdentifier property. Gitoids calculated on the Artifact Input Manifest (Input Manifest Identifier) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 Element's externalIdentifier property. See [OmniBOR Specification](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/), a minimalistic specification for describing software [Artifact Dependency Graphs](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-dependency-graph-adg).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: metrics
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to metrics related to package such as OpenSSF scorecards.
A value used in a key-value pair with a generic key that refers to an Element
Provides an unambiguous mechanism for conveying a URI fragment portion of an Element ID.
The element that has it's responsibility changed.
A point representing the mean position of the matter in a body or system.
Class that describes an action that has occurred.
An Individual Value for Element representing a set of Elements of unknown identity or cardinality (number).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: npm
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to an npm package. The package locator format is defined in the [npm documentation](https://docs.npmjs.com/cli/v10/configuring-npm/package-json) and looks like `package@version`.
A string in the license expression format.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: descendantOf
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element is a descendant of each `to` Element.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.1/terms/Software/SoftwareArtifact is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: createdBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element's Action or DefinedProcess is createdBy `to` Agent(s).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: altWebPage
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to an alternative web page.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: copiedTo
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has been copied to each `to` Element.
Country for which export controls must be taken into account.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.1/terms/Core/Artifact is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: purchaseOrder
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a purchase order for a package.
A key used in a generic key-value pair.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: componentNotPresent
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The software is not affected because the vulnerable component is not in the product.
Identifier for product production batch.
evidenceCategory refers to a category of documented or observable proof.
Enumeration of the different kinds of SPDX file.
Describes a sensor used for collecting the data.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: pretrainedOn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has been pretrained on the `to` Element(s).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: underInvestigationFor
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Vulnerability impact is being investigated for each `to` Element. The use of the `underInvestigationFor` type is constrained to `VexUnderInvestigationVulnAssessmentRelationship` classed relationships.
The relative file name of a file to be excluded from the `PackageVerificationCode`.
Categories of presence or absence.
Protocols which support authentication.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasOutput
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Build, DefinedProcess or Action element generates each `to` Element as an output.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: webpage
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Absolute URL that can be used to locate a resource, as defined in [RFC 7230](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc7230/) Section 2.7.1 or Section 2.7.2.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityFix
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the patch or source code that fixes a vulnerability.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: cwe
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Common Weakness Enumeration](https://csrc.nist.gov/glossary/term/common_weakness_enumeration). A reference to a source of software flaw defined within the official [CWE List](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/) that conforms to the [CWE specification](https://cwe.mitre.org/).
Version identifier for the hardware product.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasSpecification
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is a specification for the `from` Element (`from` hasSpecification `to`), during a LifecycleScopeType period.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasResolution
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` ResolutionAction point to the `to` OutOfSpecAction that is addressed.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: directDownload
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Dataset is publicly available and can be downloaded directly.
Specifies the type of a content identifier.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: runsOn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element (the instructions) of runs on each `to` Hardware (processing element), during a LifecycleScopeType period.
Additional relevance information.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasEvidence
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is considered as evidence for the `from` Element (`from` hasEvidence `to`).
The ProcessReadinessType is defined by the enumeration.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: packagedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is a packaged instance of the `from` Element (`from` packagedBy `to`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityAdvisory
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a published security advisory (where advisory as defined per [ISO 29147:2018](https://www.iso.org/standard/72311.html)) that may affect one or more elements, e.g., vendor advisories or specific NVD entries.
The planned location that a good, product or material is inspected.
Location of a specific action.
The DefinedType class associates a specific type with its defined source.
The location for dropping off or delivering a package or item.
Defines the level of automation a system possesses.
Provides the license under which the SPDX documentation of the Element can be used.
Artifact representing a serialization instance of SPDX data containing the definition of a particular Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasTest
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is a test artifact for the `from` Element (`from` hasTest `to`), during a LifecycleScopeType period.
Specifies the exploit catalog type.
The location that an item will be dropping off or delivered.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: pass
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Indicates a successful evaluation where the requirement or condition is clearly met.
Enumeration of dataset types.
This is the state of an affected Element.
